description.value: A small community heritage museum in the remote former gold-mining town of Bralorne, housed in the historic post office building. Bralorne sits at the end of a long mountain road in the Bridge River Valley, making it an adventurous destination for touring cyclists exploring the backcountry of the Squamish-Lillooet region. The museum is operated under the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District's heritage program.
